title: Definitions Specific to this Section:
summary: The text covers TATA AIG Travel Insurance - International Plus Health sections: Section 34 Frequent Flyer Cover reimburses reward points for journey cancellation if ticket was purchased with points, trip cancellation claim is admissible, and points are not restored. Section 35 Loss of Electronic Portable Items reimburses theft replacement cost, requiring a police report within 4 hours, excluding business items, musical instruments, stored data, loss/damage, and losses in India, with definitions of electronic portable items and business items. Section 36 Lifestyle Modification Cover reimburses artificial limbs and home/vehicle modifications due to accidental disablement, subject to accepted accidental death and disablement claim. Section 37 Child Education Benefit pays surviving eligible children if insured dies within 365 days from accident, with conditions on maximum liability, equal division, and accepted accidental death and disablement claim. title: Travel Insurance Policy Clauses on Cancellation, Multiple Policies, Discharge, Contribution
summary: This page covers several clauses from the TATA AIG Travel Insurance - International Plus Health policy. It begins with cancellation terms for the Annual Multi Trip policy, allowing cancellation with 7 days' written notice and proportionate premium refund if no claim has been reported. Section 10 on Multiple Policies outlines the insured's rights when holding multiple policies, including choosing which policy to claim under, claiming disallowed amounts from other policies, and the insurer's obligation to settle within policy limits. Section 11 on Complete Discharge states that any payment to the policyholder or related parties constitutes a valid discharge of the claim to that extent. Section 12 on Contribution specifies that for indemnity claims, if other insurance exists, the company pays only its rateable proportion, except for Medical Expenses and Accidental Death and Disablement covers.
